mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 570 and RSAFS < 360000

mechanism_narrative: In a strong industrial expansion regime (INDPRO > 102), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment level (above 129,000 thousand) indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 129000

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing sector contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicate severe real economy deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession probability rises.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 570 and GDPC1 < 13100

mechanism_narrative: In a high-CPI regime (CPIAUCSL > 215), elevated inflation expectations prompt aggressive monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215
